relation.representation: Unmodified WithdrawalAir instantiated against p3-multi-stark symbolic/prover/verifier AIR builders; no relation reimplementation or synthetic AIR
relation.public_values: 64 BabyBear values: scope, root, nullifier_hash, payout_digest, sixteen values each; payout_digest is the frozen recipient/relayer/fee binding, not raw addresses
relation.canonical_inputs: Deserialize existing WithdrawalStatement/WithdrawalWitness; check_witness before trace generation. No modulo remapping of corpus inputs.
relation.constraint_closure: Plain control uses upstream AIR metadata, beta-batched degree-generic zerocheck, repeat-last successor column opening, prescribed-point WHIR verification, and verifier evaluation of the identical AIR. No sparse matrices, unverified lookup claims, or client-supplied constraint evaluations. Frozen transitions are disabled at the last row, so the successor convention does not change H0.

This is the PCS's documented leakage of requested evaluations, not an attack on HVZK-WHIR. This repair solves the Poly interface mismatch but does not implement an outer hiding relation argument.

transcript.plain_control: Pinned WHIR DomainSeparator then explicit R2 mode and requested target; multi-stark binds instance/public metadata and trace commitment before zerocheck, opens at transcript-prescribed point. Uses upstream Poseidon2 duplex, not PQTC production transcript.
transcript.repair: Pinned hiding PCS DomainSeparator, distinct R2 mode, security request, all 64 public values; PCS commit binds commitment, open binds each point and exposed value. PCS verify absorbs commitment itself, unlike PrescribedPointPcs::verify_at which must not reabsorb it. A future wrapper must preserve this boundary, not replay/omit commitments.
transcript.claim_limit: No exact-transcript Fiat-Shamir/QROM composition theorem or quantum security claim. Native postcard only; no EVM codec equivalence claimed.

parameters.plain_control_source: Plonky3 pin multi-stark/tests/whir_fibonacci.rs config_for_stacked: folding2, starting log inverse rate1, per-round rate += folding - 1, CapacityBound, pow0. Actual arity16, not Fibonacci relation.
parameters.repair_source: Existing C20 adapter profile: folding4, initial log inverse rate2, no per-round overrides, CapacityBound, pow0, ell_zk4, mask log inverse rate1; actual arity16 replaces synthetic arity12.
parameters.derivation: Only upstream WhirConfig::new/ZkWhirConfig::new derive query counts, rates and randomness. Exact errors are retained, never replaced by guessed successful parameters.
parameters.terminal_budget: Upstream least fixed point accounts for message_len + final_queries randomized occupancy, with derived PoW gap.
parameters.security_terms: Retain complete hiding_base_case_security_report, requested target and derived configuration. The report is explicitly diagnostic ideal-IOP RBR base-case scope, not end-to-end certification. Quartic BabyBear field and CapacityBound conditions remain visible; 128 input is not 128 established security.
parameters.comparison_limit: 32-bit runs are historical-profile controls only. 128-bit derivation requests do not establish security normalization. Do not rank either against a stronger qualified backend.

spartan_branch.observed_api: PoseidonZkProvingKey/PoseidonZkSetupConfig and R1csShape; setup uses explicit DirectSparse or Spark matrix closing. engine::F is KoalaBear, not BabyBear.
spartan_branch.fit: H0 BabyBear AIR cannot be substituted as KoalaBear arithmetic. Exact non-native lowering needs canonical BabyBear residues, quotient/carry range constraints for each field operation, and multiplication gates reducing x^7; alternatively port engine/PCS to BabyBear and rederive security. Neither is a drop-in native exact H0 adapter.
spartan_branch.closure: Public API accepts explicit sparse A/B/C; DirectBindLayout/DirectMultiplyLayout are crate-private. Structured Kronecker/selector MLE evaluation would require an actual engine extension closing every matrix evaluation against a fixed relation, not dropping SPARK authentication or calling an unbound evaluator.
spartan_branch.disposition: Not chosen over existing BabyBear multi-stark path; source/API assessment, NOT measured architecture or gas failure. No generic sparse-matrix expansion by default.
